title: Shimla-Manali with Sissu : The Himachal Odyssey
route: Delhi — Manali — Solang — Atal Tunnel — Sissu — Kullu — Shimla — Kufri — Delhi
tags: Himalayan Backpacking, Group Tour, Scenic Escapes, Manali Shimla Circuit, Mountain Vibe
about_text:
Leave behind the chaotic rhythm of the plains and surrender to the timeless call of the Western Himalayas with Awara Banjara’s Himachal Odyssey. Crafted specifically for slow travelers, families, and couples seeking seamless comfort paired with untamed mountain charm, this 7-Day / 6-Night customized circuit seamlessly connects two of Himachal Pradesh's most iconic alpine realms—the bohemian deodar valleys of Manali and the colonial ridge heritage of Shimla.

Your expedition begins with a smooth overnight AC Volvo ride from Delhi, winding past foothills into the pine-scented embrace of the upper Beas Valley. Waking up in Manali, you are welcomed by crisp Himalayan breezes and towering peaks. Over the next two days, immerse yourself in the soul of the valley: walk beneath the ancient, moss-laden deodar canopy surrounding the historic Hadimba Devi Temple, find quiet mindfulness at serene Tibetan monasteries, and stroll through the lively, vibrant lanes of the Mall Road. 

The journey ascends into raw alpine drama as you drive past Solang Valley and cross the engineering marvel of the Atal Tunnel. Emerging onto the other side reveals the stark, windswept wonderland of Lahaul Valley and the glacial cascades of Sissu village by the Chandra River—a surreal contrast of trans-Himalayan landscapes and rushing mountain streams.

Transitioning from the raw valleys to colonial nostalgia, your private dedicated cab charts a scenic overland drive through the apple orchards and river gorges of Kullu Valley. Stop along the Beas River to capture the rush of white-water rapids before ascending toward Shimla, the historic 'Queen of Hills.' 

In Shimla, experience the elegance of a bygone era. Wander across the open expanse of the heritage Ridge, admire the neo-Gothic silhouette of Christ Church, and take in panoramic mountain vistas from the sacred heights of Jakhoo Temple. A dedicated day excursion takes you higher into Kufri’s alpine ridges, nestled amidst dense cedar forests and panoramic Himalayan viewpoints.

Designed with complete flexibility and unhurried pacing, this private Himachal tour package includes 2 nights in Manali and 2 nights in Shimla at handpicked mountain retreats, wholesome MAP meals (4 breakfasts and 4 dinners), overnight Volvo connectivity from Delhi, and a private cab for all intercity and local sightseeing. Experience Himachal Pradesh not just as a tourist checking off spots, but as a wanderer embracing the genuine warmth, high-altitude air, and nomadic freedom of the mountains.

itinerary.title: Overnight Journey from Delhi
itinerary.details: Assemble at the designated pickup hub in Delhi (Majnu Ka Tilla / Kashmiri Gate) by 6:30 PM. Board your comfortable semi-sleeper AC Volvo and settle in as the bustling plains give way to misty mountain foothills on an overnight drive toward the upper Beas Valley.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Wake up to crisp mountain air and panoramic valley views. Arrive in Manali by morning, where your private cab receives you for a smooth check-in at your hotel. After unwinding and having lunch, step out for private local exploration—visit the 500-year-old wooden Hadimba Devi Temple ensconced in towering deodars, discover peace at the Tibetan Monastery, stroll the pine-lined trails of Van Vihar, and spend your evening exploring the lively cafes and vibrant handicrafts of Mall Road. Return to your stay for dinner and an overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel & Sissu
itinerary.details: Relish a wholesome morning breakfast before heading out in your private vehicle toward Solang Valley, celebrated for its alpine meadows and panoramic views. Cross through the monumental 9.02 km Atal Tunnel to enter the raw, dramatic wonderland of Lahaul Valley. Explore the turquoise streams, cascading waterfalls, and willow groves of Sissu village set against towering barren peaks. Drive back through the tunnel to Manali by evening for a relaxed dinner and overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali to Shimla via Kullu Valley
itinerary.details: Enjoy breakfast, check out, and embark on a picturesque overland drive following the roaring Beas River through Kullu Valley. Stop along the way to witness the river rapids (optional white-water rafting and paragliding on self-payment) and visit local handloom outlets. Continue the scenic drive past lush apple country and mountain passes toward Shimla, the historic 'Queen of Hills.' Check into your hotel upon arrival by evening for dinner and an overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Kufri Excursion
itinerary.details: Start the day with a mountain breakfast before your private cab takes you higher to Kufri, situated at over 7,500 feet. Surrounded by dense deodar woodlands and sweeping snow-capped views, spend your day exploring the scenic trails around Mahasu Peak, taking leisure nature walks, or indulging in optional local activities. Head back to Shimla by late afternoon to enjoy a quiet, cozy evening at your stay. Dinner and overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla Exploration & Departure
itinerary.details: Savor your final mountain breakfast and complete hotel check-out. Spend the day soaking in Shimla’s rich colonial heritage—visit the revered Jakhoo Temple perched on the highest peak for panoramic bird's-eye views, walk across the iconic Ridge and historic Christ Church, and wander through Lakkar Bazaar and Mall Road for cedar wood souvenirs. By late evening, your cab drops you at the Shimla Volvo boarding point for your overnight AC Volvo ride back to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Morning Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.details: Arrive back in Delhi early in the morning (around 7:00 AM to 8:00 AM) with unforgettable memories of pine-scented valleys, high-altitude passes, and timeless Banjara wanderlust.

faqs.question: IS THIS HIMACHAL ODYSSEY A GROUP TOUR OR A PRIVATE CUSTOMIZED TRIP?
faqs.answer: This is a 100% private and customizable tour. You will have a dedicated private cab (Dzire/Etios or SUV) exclusively for your travel party for all local sightseeing and intercity transfers between Manali and Shimla, along with premium semi-sleeper AC Volvo connectivity from Delhi.

faqs.question: WHAT IS THE BEST TIME TO VISIT MANALI AND SHIMLA?
faqs.answer: March to June is ideal for pleasant weather, lush greenery, and blooming apple orchards. October to February is best for winter landscapes and snow experiences in Sissu, Solang Valley, and Kufri. The monsoon months (July to August) are generally avoided due to heavy rains.

faqs.question: ARE 4 BREAKFASTS AND 4 DINNERS INCLUDED IN THE PACKAGE?
faqs.answer: Yes, the package operates on a Modified American Plan (MAP). It includes 4 wholesome breakfasts and 4 delicious dinners prepared at your handpicked boutique hotels (2 nights stay in Manali and 2 nights stay in Shimla). Lunches and highway transit meals are not included.

faqs.question: HOW DO WE TRAVEL FROM DELHI TO MANALI AND SHIMLA TO DELHI?
faqs.answer: Your journey begins with an overnight AC semi-sleeper Volvo bus from Delhi (Majnu Ka Tilla / Kashmere Gate) to Manali. On Day 6 evening, you board an overnight AC Volvo from Shimla back to Delhi, reaching by Day 7 morning.

faqs.question: IS THE ATAL TUNNEL AND SISSU EXCURSION INCLUDED IN THIS PACKAGE?
faqs.answer: Yes, a full-day excursion covering Solang Valley, the engineering marvel Atal Tunnel (9.02 km), and Sissu village in Lahaul Valley is fully included in your private cab itinerary, subject to local weather and road clearance.

faqs.question: IS ROHTANG PASS INCLUDED IN THIS ITINERARY?
faqs.answer: No, this itinerary covers Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel, and Sissu. Rohtang Pass is not included by default because it requires special NGT permits and dedicated local union vehicles, but it can be added as an optional upgrade upon prior request.

faqs.question: WHAT SIGHTSEEING IS COVERED IN SHIMLA AND KUFRI?
faqs.answer: In Shimla, you will explore the heritage Ridge, Mall Road, Christ Church, Lakkar Bazaar, and Jakhoo Temple point. The package also includes a dedicated excursion to Kufri for panoramic Himalayan views, cedar walking trails, and Mahasu Peak.

faqs.question: CAN SENIOR CITIZENS AND FAMILIES COMFORTABLY JOIN THIS TRIP?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Because this is a private cab tour, the pace is completely relaxed and customizable. There are no strenuous treks required, making it comfortable and safe for families, couples, and senior citizens.

faqs.question: WHAT ADVENTURE ACTIVITIES CAN BE DONE EN ROUTE IN KULLU?
faqs.answer: During the drive from Manali to Shimla through Kullu Valley, you can experience white-water river rafting in the Beas River, paragliding, and river crossing on a direct self-payment basis.

faqs.question: ARE DRIVER CHARGES, TOLLS, AND FUEL EXPENSES INCLUDED?
faqs.answer: Yes, all driver allowances, fuel costs, state border entry permits, toll taxes, and designated parking fees are fully covered with zero hidden driving charges.

faqs.question: WHAT KIND OF CLOTHES AND ESSENTIALS SHOULD I PACK?
faqs.answer: We recommend layered clothing: light woolens or t-shirts for sunny daytime sightseeing, and warm jackets/fleeces for chilly evenings and high-altitude locations like Sissu and Kufri. Carry comfortable walking shoes and basic personal medications.

faqs.answer: You can easily secure your booking with a 10% non-refundable advance token payment. The remaining balance amount is payable upon your arrival in Himachal.

title: Zanskar Valley Expedition with Padum & Drang Drung
route: Delhi — Manali — Shinku La — Gombo Rangzan — Phuktal — Padum — Drang Drung Glacier — Jispa — Delhi
tags: Zanskar Valley, Overland Expedition, High Altitude, Phuktal Monastery, Shinku La Pass, 4x4 Expedition
about_text:
Awaken your inner nomad with the **Zanskar Valley Expedition**—an 8-day, high-altitude overland odyssey designed for the true offbeat explorer. Traversing roughly 1,450 km from Delhi into the raw wilderness of Ladakh and Lahaul-Zanskar, this immersive journey takes you far beyond the ordinary tourist trails.

Feel the thrill of scaling the formidable **Shinku La Pass ($16,580\text{ ft}$)** and stand in awe before the solitary, sacred rock monolith of **Gombo Rangzan**. Trek deep into the rugged Lungnak Valley to discover the breathtaking 12th-century **Phuktal Cave Monastery**, carved directly into a sheer cliff face. Unwind under a canopy of brilliant Himalayan stars by the riverbanks of Jispa, and witness the sprawling ice vistas of the **Drang Drung Glacier** from Pensi La Pass.

Curated by Himalayan veterans, this expedition blends raw 4x4 off-road exploration with soulful campfires, local homestays, and professional safety protocols—including continuous oxygen monitoring. If your soul craves silence, sweeping horizons, and untamed mountain magic, answer the call of the high Himalayas. **Book your Zanskar passage with Awara Banjara today!**

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali
itinerary.details: Assemble in Delhi by 5:00 PM for registration, roll call, and a short pre-departure orientation with your expedition coordinators. Board a premium AC Volvo coach (or dedicated expedition vehicle) and set off on an overnight journey towards Himachal Pradesh. Sit back, relax, and transition from the urban bustle to the crisp air of the Himalayan foothills.

itinerary.title: Manali Arrival
itinerary.details: Arrive in Manali by morning and check into your hotel. Dedicate the afternoon to gentle acclimatization—explore the historic Hadimba Temple, wander through the vibrant culture and cafes of Old Manali, and stroll down Mall Road. In the evening, gather for a comprehensive safety briefing, route orientation, and mandatory high-altitude gear inspection led by your expedition leader.

itinerary.title: Manali to Gombo Rangzan via Shinku La Pass
itinerary.details: Begin the high-altitude journey driving through the engineering marvel of the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul Valley. Ascend the formidable Shinku La Pass ($16,580\text{ ft}$), crossing from Himachal into the rugged wilderness of Zanskar. Arrive at the foot of Gombo Rangzan, the sacred and solitary rock monolith. Enjoy an unforgettable evening of high-altitude stargazing and an overnight stay at Gombo Rangzan.

itinerary.title: Gombo Rangzan to Padum via Phuktal Monastery Hike
itinerary.details: Embark on an iconic day trek to the 12th-century Phuktal Cave Monastery, a spectacular architectural wonder built into a sheer cliff face high above the turquoise Tsarap River. Interact with local monks and experience the tranquil sanctuary of the cave complex. Return to the trail head and continue the overland drive through the striking landscapes of Lungnak Valley to reach Padum, the administrative heart of Zanskar.

itinerary.title: Padum Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Spend the day exploring the highlights of central Zanskar. Visit Karsha Monastery, the largest and most prominent Gelugpa monastery in the region, offering panoramic valley views. Later, drive up to Pensi La Pass ($14,400\text{ ft}$) to witness the jaw-dropping expanse of the Drang Drung Glacier, one of the largest glaciers in the Indian Himalayas. Return to Padum for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Padum to Jispa
itinerary.details: Bid farewell to central Zanskar and trace your route back across Shinku La Pass, descending into the lush green valley of Lahaul. Arrive at the scenic village of Jispa by late afternoon. Unwind by the Bhaga River with a warm group bonfire, sharing stories from the trail under the stars.

itinerary.title: Jispa to Manali & Overnight Journey to Delhi
itinerary.details: After breakfast, drive from Jispa back toward Manali, passing the picturesque Sissu Waterfall and re-transiting the Atal Tunnel. Arrive in Manali with free time for souvenir shopping, exploring local markets, or grabbing an early dinner. Re-group by 6:00 PM to board your overnight Volvo coach back to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.details: Reach Delhi early in the morning (between 7:00 AM and 8:30 AM). Disembark at the drop-off point, marking the end of an extraordinary high-altitude Zanskar wilderness expedition with lifelong memories.

faqs.question: WHAT ARE THE MAXIMUM ELEVATIONS REACHED ALONG THIS CIRCUIT AND HOW ARE HIGH-ALTITUDE PASSES HANDLED?
faqs.answer: The highest point encountered on this trip is Shinku La Pass, sitting at a formidable altitude of 16,580 ft (5,053 m), which serves as the gateway into the Zanskar Valley. You will also navigate through Pensi La Pass at 14,400 ft (4,390 m) while heading toward the Drang Drung Glacier. To manage altitude comfortably, the itinerary includes gradual ascents, adequate resting periods, and continuous hydration monitoring.

faqs.question: HOW PHYSICALLY DEMANDING IS THIS EXPEDITION AND WHAT FITNESS LEVEL IS REQUIRED TO PARTICIPATE?
faqs.answer: This trip is categorized as a moderate-to-challenging high-altitude overland expedition. While primary travel takes place in 4x4 or expedition vehicles, Day 4 features a multi-hour round-trip trek to the cliffside Phuktal Cave Monastery across rugged mountain terrain. Participants should possess good physical stamina, cardiovascular endurance, and basic hiking fitness to comfortably handle the trails and variable weather conditions.

faqs.question: WHAT IS THE ACCLIMATIZATION STRATEGY TO PREVENT HIGH-ALTITUDE SICKNESS (AMS) DURING THE JOURNEY?
faqs.answer: Day 2 is fully dedicated to gentle acclimatization and rest in Manali (2,050 m) before driving toward the higher mountain passes. Our team enforces a structured routine: maintaining high fluid intake, avoiding heavy physical exertion during the initial days, prohibiting alcohol consumption at high altitudes, and monitoring daily oxygen levels with pulse oximeters.

faqs.question: WHAT TYPE AND QUALITY OF ACCOMMODATIONS ARE PROVIDED THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE EXPEDITION?
faqs.answer: Accommodations are tailored to the rugged geography of Zanskar and comprise a mix of comfortable standard hotels in Manali and Padum, combined with authentic, basic homestays and scenic high-altitude campsites near Gombo Rangzan and Jispa. While clean bedding and basic sanitary facilities are provided everywhere, luxury hotel amenities should not be expected in offbeat remote wilderness zones.

faqs.question: WHAT SHOULD WE EXPECT REGARDING MOBILE NETWORK COVERAGE AND INTERNET CONNECTIVITY ALONG THE ROUTE?
faqs.answer: Mobile network connectivity is extremely sparse and intermittent once you leave the main valley hubs. Postpaid connections from BSNL and Jio offer decent signals in Padum town, but you should expect total network blackouts across Shinku La Pass, Gombo Rangzan, Phuktal Monastery, and Pensi La Pass. Travelers are strongly advised to complete urgent communications and notify family before departing Manali.

faqs.question: WHAT VEHICLES ARE DEPLOYED FOR TRANSIT AND HOW ARE OFF-ROAD RIVER CROSSINGS HANDLED?
faqs.answer: We utilize rugged 4x4 vehicles and high-clearance expedition vehicles (such as Force Urbania, Toyota Innova, Mahindra Thar, or Tempo Travelers) specifically chosen for their durability on raw off-road terrains. Our drivers are seasoned Himalayan veterans highly experienced in navigating unpaved mountain trails, gravel tracks, mudslides, and high-altitude water crossings.

faqs.question: WHAT ARE THE ESSENTIAL CLOTHING AND PERSONAL GEAR REQUIRED FOR THIS HIGH-ALTITUDE OVERLAND EXPEDITION?
faqs.answer: Essential gear includes dynamic multi-layered winter clothing, thermal base layers, a fleece jacket, a heavy down jacket rated for sub-zero temperatures, windproof/waterproof outerwear, sturdy ankle-support trekking boots, UV-blocking sunglasses, high-SPF sunscreen, lip balm, personal toiletries, a thermal flask, power banks, and a personal medical kit containing prescribed medications.

faqs.question: ARE ALL INNER LINE PERMITS, ENVIRONMENTAL FEES, AND LOCAL TOLLS INCLUDED IN THE FINAL PACKAGE COST?
faqs.answer: Yes, the package cost comprehensively includes all required Inner Line Permits (ILP), wildlife entry charges, green/environmental taxes, parking fees, and local driver allowances. There are no hidden charges or unexpected mandatory entry costs required from travelers during the trip.

faqs.question: WHAT EMERGENCY MEDICAL SUPPORT AND FIRST-AID INFRASTRUCTURE ARE CARRIED DURING THE TRIP?
faqs.answer: Every departure is led by an experienced expedition captain trained in emergency response and basic high-altitude first aid. The support vehicle carries a fully stocked medical kit, pulse oximeters, and portable emergency oxygen cylinders at all times to handle mild AMS symptoms or sudden altitude issues.

faqs.question: WHAT IS THE MEAL PLAN STRUCTURE AND HOW ARE DIETARY PREFERENCES ACCOMMODATED IN REMOTE AREAS?
faqs.answer: The package includes nutritious, freshly prepared vegetarian/egg breakfasts and dinners served at designated hotels, homestays, and camp locations. Lunches and roadside snacks during transit hours are intentionally kept flexible so travelers can sample authentic local dhabas along the route at their own pace.

From exploring Srinagar's historical monuments, vibrant floating markets, and iconic Dal Lake houseboats to witnessing the pristine meadows of Doodhpathri, Pahalgam's valleys, Gulmarg's high-altitude snow peaks via Gondola, and Sonmarg's gleaming Thajiwas Glacier—this trip brings you closer to the soul of Kashmir alongside a like-minded community of travelers.

itinerary.details: Welcome to Srinagar Airport and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Explore Srinagar's rich heritage with visits to the historical Shankaracharya Temple, Mughal Gardens (Nishant Bagh, Chashme Shahi, Botanical Garden, Pari Mahal), Hazratbal Shrine, Jamia Masjid, and local markets for shopping and snacks. Journey into the misty, pine-scented sanctuaries of Ziro Valley, where golden paddy fields meet the raw, soul-stirring rhythms of independent music. Nestled at 5,500 feet, this 7-day overland odyssey immerses you in the heart of Arunachal Pradesh during its harvest season. 
Live under starlit skies in wilderness camps, experience the sustainable heritage of the ancient Apatani tribe, and gather around late-night bonfires amidst bamboo groves and indie melodies. title: Meghalaya-Kaziranga : Backpacking Trip
route: Guwahati — Shillong — Shnongpdeng (Dawki) — Mawlynnong — Cherrapunji — Kaziranga — Guwahati
tags: Backpacking, Group Tour, Waterfall Trekking, Living Root Bridges, Wildlife Safari, Meghalaya, Kaziranga
about_text:
Welcome to the land of clouds and the home of the giants. This isn't your typical sightseeing tour; it’s a deep dive into the rainforests of the Khasi Hills and the tall grasslands of the Brahmaputra floodplains.

At Awara Banjara, we believe the North East is a feeling, not just a destination. We’ll take you walking on bridges made of living roots, swimming in crystal-clear natural pools, and sitting around bonfires in the middle of the jungle. Whether you're a solo traveler or coming with friends, you're joining a tribe that values raw experiences and slow, soulful travel.

itinerary.title: Guwahati Arrival transfer to Shillong
itinerary.details: The group will assemble at the pick-up point in Guwahati where a brief introduction by the trip captain will be provided. Afterwards, we'll head to Shillong which is a dreamy hill station nestled in the heart of Meghalaya, popularly known as the "Scotland of the East". Upon reaching Shillong, we'll check into our hotels and spend leisure time amidst nature. In the evening, we will head to the main market in Shillong to explore its lively cafes and sightseeing spots. Standard Check-In time is 01:00 PM.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Shnongpdeng
itinerary.details: After early morning breakfast, we'll head towards Dawki River (Umngot River), famous for its turquoise water that resembles a glass surface. En route, we'd visit Krang Suri Falls, where you can immerse yourself in its stunning turquoise waters. Upon arrival in Dawki, we'll check into our riverside camps in Shnongpdeng. In the evening, we'll host a bonfire (subject to weather condition), followed by dinner and an overnight stay in camps.

itinerary.title: Dawki to Cherrapunji
itinerary.details: Post breakfast, we'll indulge in thrilling adventure activities like Cliff Jumping, Boating, Snorkeling, and Kayaking in the sparkling river. Afterward, we'll head towards Cherrapunji. En route, we'll be traversing the Indo-Bangla Border as we visit Mawlynnong which holds the title of Asia's cleanest village and offers breathtaking views of the neighboring Bangladesh plains. Upon arrival in Cherrapunji, check into our hotels and spend the night soaking in bliss.

itinerary.title: Trek to Double Decker Bridge
itinerary.details: After early morning breakfast, visit Seven Sister Falls and Mawsmai Caves made of limestone with stunning stalactites. Next, visit the Single Root Bridge, explore Nongriat Village and Tyrna Village. Then start our trek to the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge and crystal-clear blue pools. Afterward, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay in Cherrapunji.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji to Shillong
itinerary.details: After early morning breakfast, check out of our hotel and head towards Shillong. En route, visit Nohkalikai waterfall (tallest plunge waterfall in Meghalaya at 1,115 ft), Garden of Caves, Laitlum Canyons panoramic viewpoint, and Elephant Falls. Upon arrival in Shillong, check into our hotel where we will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Kaziranga
itinerary.details: Embark on a scenic drive from Shillong to Kaziranga National Park traversing picturesque views of the valley and deep jungles. En route, visit the beautiful Umiam Lake surrounded by Sylvan hills. Upon arrival, check into our resorts set amidst lush flora and fauna. Spend the rest of the day rejuvenating and indulging in recreational activities within property premises.

faqs.question: Is there a permit required for Meghalaya or Assam?
faqs.answer: For Indian citizens, no Inner Line Permit (ILP) is required to visit Meghalaya or Assam. You just need to carry a valid Government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, or Driving License).

faqs.question: What is the best time for this "Forests & Falls" combo?
faqs.answer: November to April is ideal for Kaziranga Safari (park closed May to October) and clear waters in Dawki. September to October is great for chasing massive waterfalls in Meghalaya.

faqs.question: How difficult is the Double Decker Root Bridge trek?
faqs.answer: It is a physically demanding trek involving approximately 3,500 steps one way (2–3 hours down, 3–4 hours back up). Basic fitness is recommended.

faqs.question: What kind of Safari happens in Kaziranga?
faqs.answer: We offer an early morning Jeep Safari, which is great for covering more ground and spotting One-Horned Rhinos, wild buffaloes, and tigers.

faqs.question: Can I swim in the waterfalls?
faqs.answer: Yes, in designated spots like Krang Suri (life jackets mandatory). Please dress modestly while walking through the local villages.

faqs.question: What should I pack for this trip?
faqs.answer: Meghalaya: Rain poncho, sturdy trekking shoes, quick-dry towel. Kaziranga: Earthy/dull-colored clothes (khaki, olive, brown). General: Power bank, insect repellent, motion sickness meds.

faqs.question: Will I have a mobile network?
faqs.answer: Excellent 4G/5G in Shillong & Guwahati. Decent network in Cherrapunji & Kaziranga. Poor or no network in Dawki & Nongriat village.

faqs.question: What is the food like?
faqs.answer: Expect a mix of Assamese and Khasi cuisine (rice, dal, local vegetables, Jadoh, Masor Tenga). Vegetarian and vegan options are always available.

faqs.answer: We keep our groups small and intimate, usually between 10 to 16 travelers.

title: Kasol & Manali: Offbeat Himalayan Escape
route: Delhi — Manali — Atal Tunnel — Sissu — Solang Valley — Kullu — Kasol — Manikaran — Delhi
tags: Himachal, Kasol, Manali, Offbeat Escape, Budget Trip, Group Tour
about_text:
Stories aren't born inside the four walls of the city—they come alive amidst ancient deodar forests, over shared sips of steaming pahadi chai, and beside roaring mountain rivers. If you are searching for the ultimate Kasol and Manali tour package from Delhi, this 6-Day / 5-Night Offbeat Himalayan Escape by Awara Banjara is curated for modern nomads and backpackers craving authenticity over rushed tourist checklists. 

Leaving the routine chaos behind on an overnight semi-sleeper AC Volvo journey from Delhi, you step straight into the slow, soulful rhythm of the Himalayas. Discover the scenic forest trails leading to the roaring Jogini Waterfall, experience the peaceful cedar-draped courtyard of the historic Hadimba Devi Temple, and unwind through the vibrant, acoustic-filled cafe trails of Old Manali. 

The adventure ascends as we drive through the world-famous Atal Tunnel into the dramatic, high-altitude terrain of Lahaul Valley to witness the raw majesty of Sissu Waterfall and Solang Valley. Head down towards Kullu for white-water rafting and paragliding thrills before winding into the mystic pine corridors of Parvati Valley. Experience Kasol’s iconic riverside cafes, the tranquil pine-lined walk to Chalal village, and the therapeutic natural hot sulfur springs of Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara. 

Evenings are reserved for starlit skies, crackling bonfires, live music, and bonding with your new travel tribe. Designed with verified local stays, scenic transfers, curated meals, and experienced trip leaders, this is more than a holiday—it’s an unforgettable Himalayan journey. Pack your bags and experience the real mountains with Awara Banjara!

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali (Overnight Journey)
itinerary.details: Gather at the designated pickup point in Delhi by evening and meet your fellow banjaras. Board the comfortable AC Volvo as we leave behind the chaotic city buzz and roll towards the misty pine forests of Himachal. Feel the night breeze turn crisp and mountain-fresh as conversations start flowing. Overnight journey on the winding Himalayan roads under starlit skies.

itinerary.title: Mountain Awakening, Ancient Deodars & Cafe Trails
itinerary.details: Wake up to the roaring Beas River and dramatic valley views as we pull into Manali. Check-in to our cozy stay, freshen up, and take in the slow mountain rhythm. Later, set out on a scenic walk through the apple orchards up to the roaring Jogini Waterfall, followed by a soulful visit to the age-old Hadimba Devi Temple wrapped in giant cedar trees. As dusk settles, stroll down Mall Road and spend the evening soaking in the bohemian energy of Old Manali cafes with warm chai and live acoustic tunes. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Crossing the Atal Tunnel to the Raw Vistas of Sissu & Solang
itinerary.details: Fuel up with a hearty breakfast and gear up for an unforgettable high-altitude drive. We cross the engineering marvel, Atal Tunnel, transitioning from lush green slopes into the raw, dramatic, snow-draped landscapes of Lahaul Valley. Explore the majestic Sissu Waterfall and soak in the raw nomadic silence of the mountains. On our way back, stop by Solang Valley for panoramic views and thrilling snow vibes before returning to Manali for a warm, community dinner. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Kullu Adrenaline to the Psychedelic Charm of Parvati Valley
itinerary.details: Bid farewell to Manali and hit the road towards Kullu. For the thrill-seekers, charge your adrenaline with white-water rafting in the icy Beas or soar high in the skies with paragliding (own expense). By afternoon, the valley shifts colors as we enter the mystic, pine-scented corridor of Kasol. Check-in to our riverside stay, sit by the gushing Parvati River, hop through aesthetic Israeli cafes, and gather around a cozy bonfire under the starry night sky with acoustic jams and stories. Overnight stay in Kasol/Parvati Valley.

itinerary.title: Manikaran Hot Springs, Chalal Pine Trails & Farewell Vibe
itinerary.details: Start the day with peaceful vibes by visiting the revered Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and dip your feet in the naturally therapeutic hot sulfur springs. Later, take a serene walk along the iconic suspension bridge to Chalal village—breathing in the damp pine scent and exploring hidden graffiti cafes. Pick up dreamcatchers, boho woolens, and raw souvenirs from Kasol market. By evening, gather your backpacks with a heavy heart and board your return Volvo from Bhuntar/Kasol back to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi Arrival (Carry the Banjara Soul Home)
itinerary.details: Reach Delhi early in the morning. Say goodbye to your mountain tribe with a camera roll full of aesthetic memories, tired legs, and a refreshed nomadic soul until the next adventure calls.

title: Zanskar Moto-Passage: The Monolith Circuit
route: Manali — Sissu — Gonbo Rangjon — Phuktal Gompa — Jispa
tags: High Altitude, Zanskar, Monasteries, Valleys, Motorcycling, Expedition
about_text:
Embark on an exhilarating high-altitude adventure into the heart of the raw and mystical Zanskar Valley. Starting from Manali, this 4-day motorcycle expedition takes you through the world-famous Atal Tunnel, across the towering Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft), and deep into one of the most remote corners of the Himalayas.

On this journey, you'll ride past the legendary monolith peak of Gonbo Rangjon—revered as the sacred mountain of Zanskar—and trek to the breathtaking cliffside Phuktal Monastery, built directly into a massive natural cave. Designed for thrill-seekers and culture enthusiasts alike, this route blends rugged mountain passes, serene Himalayan valleys, and rich Tibetan Buddhist heritage into an unforgettable motorcycling circuit.

title: Ladakh: High Passes & Blue Waters Expedition
route: Leh — Khardung La — Nubra Valley (Hunder & Turtuk) — Shyok River — Pangong Tso — Chang La — Leh
tags: Group Tour, High Altitude, Ladakh, Pangong Lake, Khardung La, Himalayan Expedition
about_text: Experience the magical landscape of Ladakh across 6 days and 5 nights. Journey through the highest motorable passes like Khardung La and Chang La, explore the cold desert of Nubra Valley and Hunder, visit the last northern village of Turtuk, and marvel at the changing blues of Pangong Tso via the scenic Shyok River route. Complete with visits to Diskit Monastery, Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, and Leh Market.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh & Local Exploration
itinerary.details: Arrive at Leh airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the first half of the day resting completely to adjust to the high altitude and allow proper acclimatization. In the late afternoon, embark on a light exploration starting with the historic Leh Palace, followed by panoramic views at Shanti Stupa, and wrap up your evening strolling through the vibrant Leh Market.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass
itinerary.details: Begin an exhilarating drive ascending the iconic Khardung La Pass, one of the world's highest motorable roads. Enjoy dramatic Himalayan vistas before descending into the picturesque Nubra Valley. Pay a visit to the ancient Diskit Monastery to marvel at the giant Maitreya Buddha statue, then head to Hunder to witness the famous cold desert sand dunes and ride the unique double-humped Bactrian camels.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Turtuk Village
itinerary.details: Set out on a captivating day trip along the Shyok River to Turtuk, a picturesque village near the Line of Control annexed by India during the 1971 war. Stroll through lush apricot orchards, interact with the warm local community, explore traditional stone houses, and immerse yourself in the unique Balti culture and rich history that sets this northernmost border village apart.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Pangong Tso via Shyok River Route
itinerary.details: Depart Nubra Valley and take the scenic, offbeat route along the roaring Shyok River toward the world-famous high-altitude Pangong Tso Lake. Arrive at the breathtaking turquoise lake in the late afternoon, take time to soak in the dramatic shifting hues of the water, and enjoy an unforgettable evening under a blanket of stars at your lakefront campsite.

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso to Leh via Chang La Pass
itinerary.details: Wake up early to catch a breathtaking sunrise painting the crystal-clear waters of Pangong Tso. After breakfast, journey back to Leh crossing the formidable Chang La Pass, stopping briefly at the top for photos. En route, make stops to visit the historic Thiksey Monastery and Rancho School before reaching Leh for evening leisure and souvenir shopping.

itinerary.title: Airport Departure
itinerary.details: Enjoy a morning breakfast at the hotel before getting transferred to the Leh airport. Bid farewell to the land of high passes as you board your flight home with unforgettable Himalayan memories.

title: Spiti Circuit & Chandratal Lake Moto-Expedition
route: Delhi — Manali — Jibhi — Sangla — Kalpa — Kaza — Chandratal — Manali — Delhi
tags: Group Tour, Motorbike Expedition, High Altitude, Spiti Circuit, Road Trip, Volvo Package
about_text: Embark on an iconic 11-Day / 10-Night Himalayan Moto-Expedition starting with an overnight Volvo journey from Delhi to Manali. Ride through the scenic, lush valleys of Jibhi and Sangla, venture to Chitkul—the last inhabited village near the Indo-China border—and climb to Kalpa for stunning sunset views over the Kinner Kailash range. As you cross into the rugged, high-altitude landscapes of Spiti Valley along the Hindustan-Tibet Highway, explore historic sites like Gue and key highland hamlets including Hikkim, Komic, and Langza. Conquer the challenging Kunzum Pass (14,931 ft), experience high-altitude camping under the stars near the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake, and ride back to Manali via the famous Atal Tunnel, accompanied by experienced trip captains, mechanics, inner line permits, and full safety support.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali (Volvo Transfer)
itinerary.details: Board an overnight Volvo bus from Delhi to Manali. Settle in for a comfortable journey towards the mountains. Report at the Delhi pickup point in the evening. Meet your group, board the AC semi-sleeper Volvo, and relax on the overnight drive through the northern plains towards Himachal Pradesh.

itinerary.title: Manali to Jibhi
itinerary.details: Arrive in Manali, collect and test-ride bikes for riders, and transfer to Jibhi/Gushaini. Check in, explore the valley, dinner, and overnight stay. Reach Manali in the morning, complete bike handovers/test rides for riders, and start driving towards Jibhi. Check into your cozy stay, explore the peaceful valley trails, and enjoy dinner by the bonfire.

itinerary.title: Jibhi Local Exploration
itinerary.details: Enjoy a relaxed morning exploring Jibhi's waterfalls and local cafes before preparing for the high-altitude leg ahead. Take a short woodland walk to Jibhi Waterfall and relax at charming local cafes. In the afternoon, attend a trip and safety briefing with your ride captain to prepare for the high-altitude terrain ahead.

itinerary.title: Jibhi to Sangla Valley
itinerary.details: Drive 8 hours via Rampur to Sangla Valley. Visit Chitkul, the last inhabited village of India near the Indo-China border. Drive along the scenic Sutlej River into Kinnaur Valley. Head straight to Chitkul—the last village on the Indo-China border—to walk along the pristine Baspa River before checking in for an overnight stay in Sangla.

itinerary.title: Sangla Valley to Kalpa
itinerary.details: Ride 4-5 hours to Kalpa. Visit the famous Suicide Point, witness the breathtaking sunset over the Kinner Kailash range, and stay overnight. Take a short, scenic drive up to Kalpa. Stop at the thrilling Suicide Point cliff for panoramic valley views, and catch a stunning sunset over the sacred Kinner Kailash peak.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Kaza (Spiti Valley)
itinerary.details: Drive along the Hindustan-Tibet Highway. See Khab confluence, Reo Purgyil view, Malling Nallah, and the 500-year-old mummy at Gue. Overnight in Kaza. Enter the cold desert of Spiti via the Hindustan-Tibet Highway. Stop at the Khab river confluence, cross Malling Nallah, visit the 500-year-old mummy in Gue village, and arrive in Kaza for the night.

itinerary.title: Kaza High Altitude Villages Exploration
itinerary.details: Visit the world's highest post office at Hikkim, highest motorable village at Komic, and Langza Buddha statue under Chau Chau Kang Nelda peak. Send a postcard from Hikkim's world-highest post office, visit Komic's iconic monastery, and see the giant golden Buddha statue in Langza set against snow-capped peaks. Return to Kaza by evening.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal Lake
itinerary.details: Ride from Kaza towards Chandratal Lake via Lossar and the majestic Kunzum Pass (14,931 ft). Cross rugged terrains and water streams to reach the campsite. Check in at the high-altitude camp near Chandratal, enjoy a trek to the crescent-shaped sacred lake, and spend the night stargazing under clear mountain skies.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali
itinerary.details: Ride 7-8 hours from Chandratal to Manali passing Batal, Chattru, and through the iconic Atal Tunnel. Overnight in Manali. Navigate rugged dirt tracks and water streams through Batal and Chattru. Cross into Lahaul Valley and drive through the famous 9-km Atal Tunnel back into green Manali. Hand back bikes and rest at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi Departure
itinerary.details: Self-exploration in Manali during the day. Board the overnight Volvo bus back to Delhi in the evening. Enjoy a free day in Manali—visit Old Manali cafes, Hadimba Temple, or shop on Mall Road. Board the evening Volvo bus back to Delhi, arriving the following morning

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.details: Arrive at the Delhi pickup point early in the morning. Disembark with unforgettable memories of your Spiti circuit expedition.

title: Buran Ghati: Where The Trail Ends
route: Shimla — Janglik — Dayara Thachh — Litham — Chandernahan — Dhunda — Buran Pass — Barua — Shimla
tags: Himalayan Trek, High Altitude, Pass Crossing, Snow Rappelling, Shimla, Kinnaur, Adventure
about_text: Buran Ghati is the boundary where Shimla’s lush soul meets Kinnaur’s rugged spirit. Known as the "Untouched Frontier," this 7-day high-altitude trek takes you from the historic wooden homes of Janglik to the vast Dayara Meadows, sacred Chandernahan glacial lakes, and base camp at Dhunda. Experience the thrilling technical descent down vertical snow walls using ropes before concluding in the fairytale village of Barua.

itinerary.details: Enjoy a final breakfast in Barua before driving back through the mountains to Shimla, arriving by late evening.

route: Srinagar — Kargil — Leh — Khardung La — Nubra Valley — Pangong Tso — Hanle — Umling La — Tso Moriri — Sarchu — Manali

about_text:
Cross the high-altitude frontier where ancient trade paths meet the raw, unyielding beauty of the Trans-Himalayas. This 11-day overland traverse takes you from the lush, pine-scented vales of Srinagar across legendary high passes into the cold desert sanctuaries of Ladakh, before dropping down into the pine forests of Manali. 

Experience the nomadic quietude of Hanle’s stargazing skies, gaze into the sapphire expanse of Tso Moriri, ride through the stark expanse of the More Plains, and stand at Umling La—the highest motorable road on Earth. Crafted for wanderers seeking true high-altitude immersion, this route blends raw mountain grit with seamless Banjara hospitality.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival & Kashmiri Dusk
itinerary.details: Land in the summer capital, settle into your stays along the serene valley, meet your expedition leaders, and enjoy an evening orientation under the mountain twilight.

itinerary.title: Across the Zoji La to Kargil
itinerary.details: Leave the green meadows of Sonamarg behind and climb the rugged switchbacks of Zoji La (3,528m). Descend through Drass, the gateway to Ladakh, and unwind in historic Kargil.

itinerary.title: Trans-Himalayan Crossing to Leh
itinerary.details: Traverse Namika La and Fotu La, witness the lunar landscapes of Lamayuru, pay respects at Pathar Sahib Gurudwara, and watch the sacred confluence of the Indus and Zanskar rivers before reaching Leh.

itinerary.title: High Pass to the Valley of Flowers
itinerary.details: Ascend the iconic Khardung La (5,359m) into the stark expanse of Nubra Valley. Pay homage at Diskit Monastery and watch the dusk settle over the cold desert dunes of Hunder.

itinerary.title: Along the Shyok to Pangong Tso
itinerary.details: Follow the winding turquoise path of the Shyok River through remote hamlets, breaking out onto the surreal, multi-hued shoreline of Pangong Tso for an lakeside wilderness stay.

itinerary.title: Frontier Trails to Starlit Hanle
itinerary.details: Journey past the Rezang La War Memorial and cross Loma Bridge into the serene high-altitude plateau of Hanle, home to dark sky reserves and ancient stillness.

itinerary.title: Summit of the World — Umling La Excursion
itinerary.details: Ride to the roof of the planet over Photi La to reach Umling La (5,640m). Gaze over the desolate Tibetan borderlands and explore Demchok before returning to Hanle.

itinerary.title: Sacred Waters of Tso Moriri to Leh
itinerary.details: Traverse the wild, high plains to the quiet shores of Kyagar Tso and Tso Moriri. Soak in the solitude of Changthang before tracing the Indus back to Leh.

itinerary.title: Crossing the Great Plains to Sarchu

itinerary.title: Manali Solitude & Homeward Journey

title: Spiti : The Highland Circuit (Group Trip)
route: Delhi — Manali — Kaza — Langza — Komic — Hikkim — Key Monastery — Chicham Bridge — Kunzum Pass — Chandratal — Manali — Delhi
tags: Spiti Valley, Highland Circuit, Shared Ride, Road Trip, Group Tour
about_text: This 7-day expedition takes travelers from the green pine valleys of Manali into the high-altitude cold desert of Spiti Valley. Experience driving through the engineering marvel of Atal Tunnel, crossing the high mountain passes of Kunzum, and exploring iconic high-altitude villages. Highlights include mailing a postcard from the World’s Highest Post Office in Hikkim, witnessing the giant golden Buddha of Langza, driving across Asia’s highest suspension bridge at Chicham, visiting the historic Key Monastery, and spending an unforgettable night camping under the stars near the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake.

itinerary.title: Delhi or Chandigarh to Manali
itinerary.details: Your incredible Himalayan adventure begins as you board your vehicle or comfortable overnight Volvo bus from Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening. Settle into your seat, leave the city hustle behind, and enjoy a smooth, relaxing night journey as you wind your way up towards the cool, fresh air and green hills of Himachal Pradesh.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Manali & Local Town Exploration
itinerary.details: Arrive in Manali by morning and check into your hotel. Take some time to freshen up, unpack, and let your body rest and adjust to the mountain weather. In the afternoon, head out to explore Manali's cultural heart. Visit the famous wooden Hadimba Temple nestled inside a dense pine forest, take a refreshing stroll around the natural Vashisht Hot Springs, and spend your evening shopping for souvenirs, eating local snacks, and enjoying the lively vibe of Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kaza via Atal Tunnel & Kunzum Pass
itinerary.details: Wake up early for the most thrilling day of your trip! Leave green Manali behind and drive straight through the magnificent Atal Tunnel. The moment you exit the other side, the landscape changes dramatically from lush green valleys to a breathtaking, rugged cold desert. Drive along the wild riverbeds of Lahaul Valley and ascend the mighty Kunzum Pass, stopping at the sacred temple to seek blessings for a safe journey. By evening, arrive in Kaza, the vibrant and charming main town of Spiti Valley.

itinerary.title: Exploring High Villages — Langza, Hikkim & Komik
itinerary.details: Today is all about visiting some of the highest human settlements on Earth! Your first stop is Langza, a picturesque village famous for its giant golden Buddha statue sitting peacefully against massive snow-capped mountains. Next, drive up to Hikkim to visit the World’s Highest Post Office—don't forget to write a real postcard to your family or friends from over 14,000 feet! Conclude your village tour at Komik, one of the highest motorable villages in the world, before returning to Kaza town for a cozy evening.

itinerary.title: Key Monastery, Kibber Village & Chicham Bridge
itinerary.details: After a hearty breakfast, head out to visit the iconic Key Monastery, a magnificent multi-tiered Tibetan Buddhist monastery perched dramatically on a steep hilltop. Step inside to explore peaceful prayer halls, ancient murals, and share a cup of warm tea with the resident monks. Afterward, drive up to Kibber, a historic village known for its traditional stone houses. The ultimate highlight of the day is driving across Chicham Bridge—the highest suspension bridge in Asia, hanging suspended over a jaw-dropping 1,000-foot-deep gorge! Return to Kaza by evening.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal Lake
itinerary.details: Bid farewell to Kaza as you travel toward the magical Chandratal Lake (also known as the Moon Lake). After reaching the campsite area, take a short, easy walk along the trail to reach the shores of the lake. The crystal-clear blue water perfectly mirrors the towering surrounding peaks in a way that feels completely surreal. As evening falls, head back to your cozy campsite near the lake, enjoy hot, comforting food by the dining area, and spend hours looking up at a crystal-clear night sky filled with thousands of brilliant stars.

itinerary.title: Chandratal Lake to Manali & Departure
itinerary.details: Wake up to a crisp, cold mountain morning and enjoy a warm breakfast surrounded by untouched nature. Pack your bags and begin your scenic drive back towards Manali, following the winding path of the Chandra River through the rugged mountain terrain. Pass back through the Atal Tunnel and return to the lush greenery of the Kullu Valley, arriving back in Manali by afternoon. From here, catch your evening transport or Volvo bus back home, carrying a camera full of memories and a heart full of Spiti stories!

about_text: Embark on an exhilarating 8-day winter expedition across the snow-draped landscapes of Spiti Valley in a 4x4 vehicle. Beginning with an overnight drive from Delhi to Shimla, the journey traverses through Kinnaur and Sangla Valley to Chitkul, the last village near the Indo-Tibetan border. Experience the frozen wonders of Spiti, including ancient monasteries at Gue, Tabo, and Dhankar, and explore iconic high-altitude villages like Hikkim, Komic, Langza, and Kibber. Cross the breathtaking Chicham Bridge and visit the iconic Key Monastery before returning via Kalpa with views of the majestic Kinner Kailash peak.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.details: Board your overnight Volvo bus or transit vehicle from Delhi to Shimla. As you leave the bustling urban plains behind, sit back, relax, and prepare for an exciting mountain adventure. The overnight journey allows you to rest while winding upward into the scenic Himalayan foothills, setting the stage for the thrilling winter expedition ahead in Spiti.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Chitkul via Sangla
itinerary.details: Arrive in Shimla early in the morning and meet your expedition crew before transitioning into comfortable 4x4 vehicles specially equipped for snow conditions. Embark on a dramatic drive through the Kinnaur region and the breathtaking Sangla Valley. Your destination is Chitkul, the final inhabited village near the Indo-Tibetan border. Experience the crisp winter air and snow-draped landscapes before settling in for an overnight stay in Chitkul or Sangla.

itinerary.title: Chitkul to Tabo via Nako & Gue
itinerary.details: Depart Chitkul and begin an awe-inspiring exploration drive deeper into the Spiti region toward Tabo. En route, stop to visit the serene Nako village along with its high-altitude lake frozen over during winter. Next, make a fascinating detour to Gue village to view the remarkable 500-year-old naturally mummified monk preserved at Gue Monastery. Continue onward to Tabo for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tabo to Kaza via Dhankar
itinerary.details: Start your day exploring the ancient Tabo Monastery, often called the "Ajanta of the Himalayas" for its historic frescoes and priceless artwork. After immersing yourself in its tranquil heritage, drive toward Kaza. Along the way, take a spectacular detour to the cliffside Dhankar Monastery, which dramatically overlooks the confluence of the Spiti and Pin rivers. Arrive in Kaza for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kaza High-Altitude Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Dedicate the day to exploring Spiti’s iconic high-altitude villages surrounding Kaza. Send a postcard from Hikkim, home to the world's highest post office, visit the remote high-altitude village of Komic, and admire the majestic Buddha statue at Langza. Walk across the thrilling Chicham Bridge suspended over a deep gorge, and visit the iconic snow-covered Key Monastery perched on a hilltop. Return to Kaza for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Kalpa
itinerary.details: Begin your return journey heading back toward Kinnaur to reach the charming town of Kalpa. The scenic winter drive offers dramatic views of snow-dusted valleys and pine forests. Upon arrival in Kalpa, take in the breathtaking panorama of the sacred Kinner Kailash mountain range glowing in the sunlight. Spend the evening relaxing and enjoying an overnight stay in Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Shimla
itinerary.details: Depart Kalpa and navigate the winding mountain roads back down through Kinnaur toward Shimla. Enjoy the final glimpses of high Himalayan scenery as you descend back to lower elevations. Upon reaching Shimla in the evening, board your overnight Volvo bus or transit vehicle back toward Delhi, giving you time to unwind and reflect on an unforgettable winter adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.details: Arrive early in the morning back in Delhi, marking the end of your exhilarating 8-day Spiti winter 4x4 expedition. Bring home incredible memories, photographs of frozen Himalayan landscapes, and rich cultural experiences from the remote high-altitude villages and monasteries of Spiti Valley as you head to your next destination.

title: Hamta Pass and Chandratal Trek
route: Manali — Jobra — Chika — Balu Ka Ghera — Hampta Pass — Shea Goru — Chatru — Chandratal — Manali
tags: Hamta Pass, Chandratal, High Altitude Trek, Crossover Trek, Himalayan Treks, Group Trek
about_text: Embark on a breathtaking 5-day crossover expedition on the Hamta Pass and Chandratal Trek. Starting in Manali, this moderate-level adventure transitions from the lush, green meadows of Kullu Valley to the stark, barren beauty of Spiti's cold desert. You'll summit at a thrilling 14,100 ft, witnessing glacial streams and towering Himalayan peaks along the way. The epic journey culminates with an adventurous drive to the pristine, turquoise waters of Chandratal, the Moon Lake, offering an unforgettable high-altitude Himalayan experience.

itinerary.title: Drive from Manali to Jobra (40 mins) & Trek to Chikka Campsite (3-4 Hours)
itinerary.details: Assemble at the Manali base camp where you meet your trek leaders, complete safety briefings, and receive packed lunch. Embark on an exhilarating 40-minute drive navigating 42 hairpin bends up to Jobra. From Jobra, begin your trek alongside the cascading Rani River, traversing lush mixed forests of pine, oak, and birch. Arrive at the scenic green riverside campsite of Chikka, settle into your alpine tents, and relax under the serene mountain canopy.

itinerary.title: Chikka to Balu Ka Ghera Valley (4-5 Hours Trek)
itinerary.details: Begin your 9 km gradual ascent through the breathtaking Kullu Valley toward Balu Ka Ghera (11,900 ft). The route takes you along boulder-strewn terrain, cascading waterfalls, and vibrant wildflower beds beneath towering Himalayan peaks like Deo Tibba. Brave bone-chilling glacial stream crossings that awaken your senses. Reach the expansive sandy riverbed of Balu Ka Ghera by afternoon, followed by hot mountain snacks, dinner, and an evening acoustic jam session under star-studded skies.

itinerary.title: Balu Ka Ghera to Shea Goru via Hampta Pass Summit (7-8 Hours Trek)
itinerary.details: The grand summit day! Start early for the steep, zig-zag alpine climb to the majestic Hampta Pass standing at 14,100 ft. At the crest, witness the dramatic crossover contrast—the lush, mist-draped green valleys of Kullu meeting the raw, barren, cold desert mountains of Lahaul & Spiti. After soaking in panoramic views of Indrasan and Deo Tibba, begin a careful, steady descent into the tranquil, emerald meadows of Shea Goru for an overnight riverside camp.

itinerary.title: Shea Goru to Chatru Trek (3-4 Hours) & Expedition Drive to Chandratal Lake
itinerary.details: Wake up in the tranquil Shea Goru valley and negotiate a cold-water river crossing before descending through barren rocky gorges toward Chatru. After arriving at Chatru, drop heavy luggage and board rugged 4x4 vehicles for an adventurous high-altitude road journey to the mystical Chandratal (The Moon Lake at 14,100 ft). Spend time admiring the shifting turquoise waters reflecting towering peaks before driving back to Chatru basecamp for dinner and tent stay.

itinerary.title: Chatru to Manali via Atal Tunnel & Base Camp Departure
itinerary.details: Savor a wholesome breakfast at the Chatru campsite before boarding the return transport at 8:00 AM. Experience an adventurous off-road mountain drive through Chandra Valley, passing Gramphu and crossing through the iconic 9.02 km Atal Tunnel beneath the Rohtang Ridge. Arrive back at Manali by afternoon, marking the grand finale of your Himalayan crossover expedition with lifelong memories and strong mountain bonds.

The Untamed Frontier: Where the Road Ends, the Soul Awakes
There is the Himalayas you see on postcards, and then there is Zanskar—a mystical, razor-sharp trans-Himalayan realm sculpted by roaring glacial rivers, towering vertical monoliths, and ancient Buddhist serenity. Hidden behind formidable high-altitude mountain passes, Zanskar is not just a destination; it is an initiation into the raw, unhurried wild.

Our Escape to Zanskar (6-Day Expedition) is curated for the true wanderers—those who refuse to be bound by generic tourist itineraries and seek journeys that leave dust on their boots and fire in their spirits. Spanning across legendary mountain corridors—from the verdant cedar valleys of Manali to the windswept heights of Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft), the sacred shadow of Gonbo Rangjon, and the mythical cliffside cave hermitage of Phuktal Gompa—this is trans-Himalayan road tripping in its purest, most authentic form.

The Awara Banjara Way: How We Travel
At Awara Banjara, we do not sell standardized package holidays. We curate community-led, raw mountain expeditions.

Nomadic Energy & Authentic Tribe Vibe: You don’t travel with a coach of strangers; you journey with a tribe of like-minded explorers. From sharing stories around crackling riverside bonfires in Jispa to gazing at the silver canopy of the Milky Way beside the holy monolith of Gonbo Rangjon, our journeys forge lifelong bonds.

Safety First, Always Grounded: Raw adventure does not mean reckless travel. We build our expeditions with dedicated acclimatization hikes (like the Jogini Waterfall trail in Manali), seasoned trans-Himalayan expedition captains, certified 4x4/tempo logistics, and on-board emergency oxygen and high-altitude medical support.

Slow, Immersive Storytelling: We believe in pausing where the mass crowds rush. We let you soak in the acoustic reverberations of 12th-century monastic chants inside the caves of Phuktal Gompa, taste authentic local butter tea with mountain elders, and wake up to unfiltered golden sunrises over glacial monoliths.

Key Expedition Highlights
Conquer Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft): Ascend the formidable high-mountain pass connecting Lahaul Valley to the secluded gorges of Zanskar, cutting through rugged terrains and snow-carved ridges.

Camp in the Shadow of Gonbo Rangjon: Experience an unforgettable, high-altitude starlit night camp beneath the sacred standalone monolith revered by locals as the protective deity of the valley.

Trek to the Cliff-Hanging Phuktal Cave Monastery: Embark on a dramatic hike along the turquoise Tsarap River to reach one of the world's most remote Buddhist cave monasteries, carved directly into a sheer limestone cliff.

Riverside Solace in Jispa & Lahaul: Unwind along the turquoise waters of the Bhaga River, breathing in pristine alpine air away from all urban noise.

Ready to Answer the Mountain's Call?
Zanskar is wild, unforgiving, and breathtakingly beautiful. If you are seeking an expedition that strips away the ordinary, challenges your boundaries, and reconnects your soul with the raw rhythm of the earth, your seat in the tribe is waiting. Pack your rucksack, leave the city behind, and Escape to Zanskar the Awara Banjara way.

faqs.question: What makes the Escape to Zanskar 6-day expedition by Awara Banjara unique compared to standard Ladakh or Spiti trips?
faqs.answer: Unlike commercial tourist circuits, our 6-day Zanskar overland expedition takes you into the most raw, secluded trans-Himalayan frontier. You cross the formidable Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft), camp under raw starlit skies beneath the sacred monolith of Gonbo Rangjon, and trek along the turquoise Tsarap river to the cliff-hanging 12th-century Phuktal Cave Monastery. It is curated for true wanderers who seek community vibes, off-grid adventure, and soulful storytelling rather than crowded tourist spots.

faqs.question: What are the exact pickup and drop-off points for the overnight Volvo from Delhi?
faqs.answer: For our Delhi to Manali transit on Day 1, boarding is arranged in the late evening (between 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM) from major hubs like Majnu ka Tilla or ISBT Kashmiri Gate. Return Volvo coaches drop travelers back at the same locations early in the morning on Day 6. Driver contacts, coach numbers, and precise boarding gate locations are shared directly on your trip WhatsApp group 6 to 8 hours prior to departure.

faqs.question: How physically demanding is the Phuktal Gompa (Phugtal Monastery) cliff trek?
faqs.answer: The trek to Phuktal Cave Monastery from the trail-head takes approximately 4 to 5 hours round trip along the gorge of the Tsarap/Lungnak river. It is a moderate-grade cliffside hike suitable for beginners and regular travelers with decent physical stamina. Our certified Awara Banjara trip captain leads the trail at a comfortable, steady pace with regular hydration breaks.

faqs.question: How do we handle high altitude and AMS (Acute Mountain Sickness) on this trip?
faqs.answer: Safety is our highest priority in high-altitude zones. Day 2 includes an active acclimatization hike to Jogini Waterfall in Manali before we scale Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft) on Day 3. Our backup vehicle carries a dedicated high-altitude medical kit, portable oxygen cylinder, and pulse oximeter for daily oxygen/pulse checks. Our expedition leads are fully trained in altitude safety protocols.

faqs.question: What type of stays and washroom facilities should I expect at Gonbo Rangjon and Jispa?
faqs.answer: In Manali and Jispa, we provide cozy, pre-verified standard mountain hotels/guesthouses with attached washrooms, geysers, and comfortable bedding. At Gonbo Rangjon, we stay at an off-grid riverside eco-campsite beneath the sacred monolith. Being an extreme remote wilderness zone, camp stays feature clean, insulated dome/swiss tents with dry/basic eco-washroom setups and thick bedding built to withstand sub-zero night temperatures.

faqs.question: What mobile networks work during the Zanskar circuit, and where will I find charging points?
faqs.answer: In Manali, Sissu, and Jispa, Jio and Airtel 4G networks function smoothly. Once you cross Shinku La Pass towards Gonbo Rangjon and the Phuktal trail, mobile connectivity drops completely, giving you a true off-grid wilderness detox. Charging points are available in your rooms at Manali and Jispa. We strongly recommend carrying a 20,000 mAh power bank for the Gonbo Rangjon camping night.

faqs.question: Can solo travelers, female explorers, or first-timers join this Zanskar group trip?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Over 60% of our tribe members join as solo travelers, including many solo female adventurers. We provide a safe, respectful, and lively community atmosphere with verified co-travelers, gender-segregated quad/triple/double sharing room allocations, and round-the-clock captain support.

faqs.question: What kind of meals are included during the 6-day expedition?
faqs.answer: The trip includes 6 wholesome meals on a MAP plan (3 hearty breakfasts and 3 hot, freshly prepared dinners) from Day 2 dinner in Manali to Day 5 breakfast in Jispa. Meals are vegetarian/egg-friendly, nutritious, and suited for high-altitude energy. Road-trip lunches and snacks are kept flexible so you can explore authentic local dhabas and mountain cafes.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year to undertake this high-altitude Zanskar road trip?
faqs.answer: The prime operational season for Zanskar is from late May to early October. During these months, Shinku La Pass is clear of heavy snowdrifts, river crossings are stable, and daylight temperatures remain pleasant (12°C to 20°C). Nights at high-altitude campsites like Gonbo Rangjon drop between 0°C and 5°C, making warm layering essential.

faqs.question: What kind of vehicle is used for the road expedition from Manali to Zanskar?
faqs.answer: For the rugged high-altitude terrain between Manali, Shinku La, and Gonbo Rangjon, we use sturdy, commercial-plated trans-Himalayan 4x4/tempo vehicles (Force Urbania, Tempo Traveler 4x4, or rugged SUVs) driven by certified local mountain pilots who possess deep expertise in navigating tricky rocky riverbeds and mountain passes.

faqs.question: What essential clothing and gear should I pack for the Zanskar expedition?
faqs.answer: You must follow the 3-layer clothing rule: moisture-wicking thermals, fleece/warm mid-layers, and a heavy windproof/down jacket. Also pack sturdy trekking shoes with good grip, woolen socks, UV-protection sunglasses, SPF 50+ sunscreen, a reusable 1-litre thermal flask, a headlamp/torch, personal toiletries, and a 20,000 mAh power bank.

about_text:
Spiti Full Summer Circuit: The Ultimate Himalayan Odyssey with Awara Banjara
There is travel that lets you see places, and then there is the Awara Banjara journey—where the mountains don't just surround you; they become a part of your soul. Welcome to the Spiti Full Summer Circuit (8 Days / 7 Nights), an epic overland expedition that transitions from the chaotic rhythm of city life into the raw, silence-carved landscapes of the Middle Land. Starting from Delhi and traversing through the emerald gorges of Kinnaur, ancient cliffside monasteries, the highest inhabited villages on Earth, and the mystic shores of Chandratal Lake, this is not just a road trip—it is an initiation into the true Banjara spirit.

The Journey: From Kinnaur’s Deep Gorges to the Cold Desert of Spiti
The complete Spiti circuit is widely regarded as one of the world’s most legendary high-altitude road trips. Unlike short back-and-forth routes, our full circuit enters via the gradual ascent of Shimla and Kinnaur Valley and exits through the wild, adrenaline-fueled off-road terrain of Kunzum Pass, Batal, and Manali. This clockwise route ensures natural acclimatization, allowing your body and mind to seamlessly adapt to the thin Himalayan air.

Your nomadic expedition begins with an overnight transition from Delhi into the misty pine hills of Shimla. From here, our rugged expedition vehicles roll alongside the roaring Sutlej River through the dramatic, rock-carved cliff roads of Kinnaur. Settle into the rustic beauty of Sangla Valley and Chitkul—the last inhabited village near the Indo-Tibet border—where wooden cottages, crisp mountain breezes, and views of the snow-dusted Kinnaur Kailash range set the tone for the adventure ahead.

As we cross the sacred Khab Sangam—the raw confluence of the Spiti and Sutlej rivers—the green alpine forests dramatically yield to the barren, sculpted moonscapes of the trans-Himalayan desert. Along the way, we pause by the reflective serenity of Nako Lake and take a detour to the remote outpost of Gue, home to the 500-year-old naturally preserved mummified body of Buddhist monk Sangha Tenzin.

 Ancient Monasteries & Postcards from the Clouds
In the heart of Spiti Valley, history breathes through mud brick and ancient sacred chants. Step inside the 1,000-year-old Tabo Monastery, revered as the ‘Ajanta of the Himalayas’, where sacred wall murals and ancient meditation caves transport you back across centuries. Feel your spine tingle as you gaze upon the dramatic, cliff-hanging Dhankar Gompa, standing defiantly on razor-sharp spires high above the Pin-Spiti river confluence.

Based out of the vibrant desert hub of Kaza, our high-altitude village safari takes you to the literal rooftop of the world:

Hikkim (14,567 ft): Write a heartfelt, ink-on-paper letter from the World’s Highest Post Office and send a piece of the Himalayas directly to your loved ones.

Komic (15,027 ft): Feel the quiet reverence of the World’s Highest Motorable Village, standing beneath fluttering multi-colored prayer flags.

Langza (The Fossil Village): Gaze upon the iconic giant Golden Buddha statue facing the mighty Chau Chau Kang Nilda peak, and walk across ancient shale beds to discover million-year-old marine fossils from the ancient Tethys Sea.

Over Kunzum Pass to the Mystic Waters of Chandratal
No Spiti expedition is complete without visiting the fortress-like Key Monastery, where young monks warmly offer steaming butter tea, and crossing the staggering Chicham Bridge—Asia's highest suspension bridge spanning a thousand-foot vertical gorge.

Conquer the mighty Kunzum Pass (14,931 ft), pay homage at the Kunzum Mata shrine, and descend into the hidden sanctuary of Chandratal (The Moon Lake). Hike along its ever-changing turquoise and deep-blue waters, surrounded by amphitheaters of snow-capped peaks. As night falls over our alpine campsite, sit around the warmth of community conversations and look up at the unpolluted, dazzling expanse of the Milky Way Galaxy stretching from horizon to horizon.

 The Wild Off-Road Exit via Manali & Atal Tunnel
The final leg tests the nomadic spirit on the raw off-road trails of Batal, Chhatru, and Gramphu. Navigate glacial water crossings (pagal nalas) and boulder-strewn Chenab riverbeds before piercing through the engineering triumph of the Atal Tunnel. In an instant, the arid desert transforms back into the lush, pine-scented warmth of Manali. Celebrate the triumph of completing the entire circuit with cafe hopping in Old Manali before your overnight Volvo returns you to Delhi.

Why Experience Spiti with Awara Banjara?
Raw, Authentic & Non-Commercial: We don’t run cookie-cutter tourist trips. We travel like a nomadic tribe—staying in handpicked local homestays, sharing regional food, and connecting with local cultures.

High-Altitude Safety First: Dedicated trip captains, certified drivers, continuous acclimatization management, portable medical oxygen cylinders, and emergency protocols.

Seamless, Transparent & Soulful: From permits and comfortable transport to verified stays and stargazing nights—every detail is curated so you can fully lose yourself in the mountain magic.

Pack your rucksack, leave the city routine behind, and claim your seat on the ultimate Spiti Summer Circuit. The Middle Land is calling!

faqs.question: WHAT EXACTLY IS THE "BANJARA STYLE" OF EXPERIENCING SPITI?
faqs.answer: Unlike commercial, rigid group tours, our Banjara style means traveling like a nomadic tribe—embracing raw mountain rhythms, staying in handpicked soulful homestays rather than sterile hotels, sharing local food stories around bonfire embers, and deeply connecting with local culture instead of just checking off tourist spots.

faqs.question: WHY DO WE ENTER VIA SHIMLA AND EXIT VIA MANALI IN THIS CLOCKWISE CIRCUIT?
faqs.answer: This is our secret to high-altitude survival! Entering via Kinnaur (gradual altitude climb) and exiting via Manali allows your body to naturally acclimatize to thin mountain air, drastically reducing the risk of Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) compared to direct sudden-climb routes.

faqs.question: CAN SOLO TRAVELERS AND WOMEN JOIN THIS EXPEDITION SAFELY?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! More than 60% of our tribe members are solo travelers and women. With verified local homestays, trusted expedition captains, and a tight-knit community vibe, Spiti with Awara Banjara feels like traveling with an extended family.

faqs.question: HOW COLD DOES IT GET AT CHANDRATAL LAKE AT NIGHT?
faqs.answer: Chandratal sits at a staggering 14,100 ft, meaning night temperatures can drop sharply below zero even in peak summer. However, our alpine dome camps come equipped with heavy, warm fleece-lined sleeping bags and extra bedding to keep you cozy under the Milky Way.

faqs.question: WHAT IS THE VIBE OF THE HOMESTAYS WE STAY IN?
faqs.answer: We skip luxury commercial hotels in favor of authentic, family-run Spitian homestays and scenic riverside properties. You’ll experience traditional mud-brick architecture, warm wooden interiors, local hospitality, and home-cooked meals straight from local kitchens.

faqs.question: DO I NEED ANY PREVIOUS OFF-ROAD DRIVING OR TREKKING EXPERIENCE FOR THIS TRIP?
faqs.answer: None at all! Whether you are choosing our expedition vehicle or booking a bike option, our expert road captains and support crew handle all the technical terrain, water crossings (pagal nalas), and high-pass navigation while you soak in the raw views.

faqs.question: ARE THERE NETWORK OR INTERNET CONNECTIVITY ISSUES IN SPITI VALLEY?
faqs.answer: Yes, Spiti is a digital detox zone. Postpaid BSNL and Jio sims work intermittently in major pockets like Kaza, while Kinnaur and upper Spiti have little to no network. Embrace the disconnect—the mountains are your real Wi-Fi here!

faqs.question: WHAT KIND OF FOOD CAN WE EXPECT DURING THE HIGH-ALTITUDE JOURNEY?
faqs.answer: Expect hearty, freshly prepared North Indian meals along with authentic Spitian delicacies like Thukpa, Momos, Tingmo, and butter tea. We also keep lunch stops open in local village cafes so you can explore regional flavors at your own pace.

faqs.question: WHAT SHOULD I PACK TO HANDLE RAPID WEATHER CHANGES IN SPITI?
faqs.answer: Spiti is famous for four seasons in a single day—intense high-altitude sun, biting mountain winds, and sudden evening chills. Layering is your best friend: pack thermal innerwear, windproof/waterproof jackets, UV sunglasses, sunscreen, sturdy trekking shoes, and a woolen beanie.

faqs.question: HOW DO WE MANAGE MEDICAL EMERGENCIES OR HIGH ALTITUDE SICKNESS?
faqs.answer: Safety is our absolute priority. Every Awara Banjara vehicle is equipped with a comprehensive first-aid kit, a portable medical oxygen cylinder, and an oximeter. Our trip captains are trained to monitor oxygen levels and handle high-altitude transitions smoothly.

faqs.question: CAN I CHARGE MY PHONES AND CAMERA BATTERIES REGULARLY?
faqs.answer: Electricity is available at most homestays in Sangla, Tabo, and Kaza during evening supply hours. However, remote sectors like Chandratal camping have limited or solar-powered charging. We strongly recommend carrying a high-capacity power bank.

faqs.question: WHY IS THE BOOKING TOKEN NON-REFUNDABLE IN THE AWARA BANJARA POLICY?
faqs.answer: Our token amount is immediately utilized to secure high-demand permits, advance bookings in remote boutique homestays, and dedicated expedition transport months in advance. Since Spiti operates on a very short seasonal window, this ensures your slot and logistics are 100% locked in.
